analytics.name: Analytic 2050
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies execution of port scanning utilities (nmap, masscan) with arguments targeting Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol port ranges on an ICS Windows host. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.

tuning.description: Time window within which connections across multiple ports are considered a single scan event.

log_sources.name: WinEventLog:Sysmon
log_sources.channel: EventCode=1 of port scanning utility with arguments targeting Industrial Control Systems (ICS) protocol port ranges
